judge.summary: The patient attempted to ask for clinic hours, parking information, and new patient requirements. The agent ignored the patient's request for information and attempted to force a booking. When the patient reiterated that she had questions first, the agent immediately terminated the call by transferring the patient to a non-existent front desk.

conversation_quality.notes: The agent failed to listen to the patient's stated intent and instead prioritized an aggressive booking flow.

agent_quality.notes: The agent refused to answer basic factual questions and instead deflected to a transfer, which resulted in the call ending.

technical_quality.notes: No technical issues noted; the failure was purely behavioral.

candidate_issues.title: Refusal to answer factual questions
candidate_issues.quote: I understand you have some questions, but I'll need to transfer you to our front desk staff to assist you with those.
candidate_issues.expected: The agent should have answered the questions regarding hours, address, and parking directly.
candidate_issues.why_it_matters: The agent is designed to provide information; refusing to do so and transferring the caller defeats the purpose of the receptionist role.
candidate_issues.matches_hypothesis: Agent says it will transfer the caller and ends the call instead of answering an answerable question about hours, address, insurance or policies

candidate_issues.title: Aggressive booking attempt
candidate_issues.quote: I can certainly get you scheduled with our specialist, Dr. Emily Chen. Would you like to come in next Tuesday at 10:00 am or Wednesday at 2:00 pm?
candidate_issues.expected: The agent should have acknowledged the patient's interest and invited the questions first.
candidate_issues.why_it_matters: The agent ignored the patient's explicit statement that she had questions before booking.
candidate_issues.matches_hypothesis: Agent steers into scheduling or "books" a visit despite the caller declining
